realtime_memories.content: portfolio-website (Vite + React, no router) is for "Tanisha Brahma" (SOC / detection engineering / applied cryptography). GitHub: github.com/Junecoderr/portfolio-website (origin/main), gh CLI authenticated as myselfRaifMondal, Vercel deploys main to portfolio-website-junix1.vercel.app. Commits go straight to main per user preference.

2026-09-05 rebuild (commit 411976d): site now implements Claude Design project 99589604-0d37-4541-8fee-0f4d3033830f, file "Tanisha Portfolio.dc.html" (third-party-inspired design filled with Tanisha's content). Single-page scroll layout: preloader, glass nav + drawer, serif hero with rotating word, About bento slider + portrait, skill marquees, experience cards, four work cards opening case-study dialogs, four-step mailto contact form, big-type footer. Earlier five-route design and its LatticeScene / HeroCipherField / ds components were removed. Reading the design requires a successful /design-login; a plain /login token gets HTTP 403 from the design API. Follow-ups the same day: mobile pass (commit 612e332 — one-line nav brand down to 360px, pills wrap, work grid min capped at container width, dialog docks to bottom, portrait served as responsive WebP via <picture>, viewport-fit=cover + theme-color) and favicon set (commit e2a29cf — TB signature traced from the Bastliga outlines into public/favicon.svg, plus favicon-32.png, apple-touch-icon.png, icon-512.png rendered from the font). Verify mobile at 360px and 390px with Playwright element screenshots per section. Polish pass (commit 8e68cdb) applied all 20 critique items: hero status pill + role line + scroll cue + dark scrim, body copy in Geist not mono, natural-width footer wordmarks, 2x2 work grid with hover lift/glow, outlined section numbers, scroll-reveal via src/hooks/useScrollReveal.js, cyan-only palette, monochrome skill chips, content band fade, inline desktop nav links, 11px label floor, 36-40px touch targets, 1.3s preloader. UX pass (2026-09-06): section order is Hero, Work (02), About (03), Experience (04), Recognition (05), Skills (06), Contact (07). Case studies are hash-routed (#work/<id>) with pushState, popstate/hashchange sync, Escape and back-button close, focus trap and focus return; deep links skip the preloader, which is otherwise gated to once a day in localStorage. Contact leads with the email plus a copy button and detects whether the mailto opened via window blur. Footer nav replaced by Direct column (email + PGP fingerprint, copy buttons). Skills are three static columns with 'core' tags plus one decorative marquee that pauses off-screen. Nav has active-section highlight (IntersectionObserver) and a scroll progress bar. Background shader stops on prefers-reduced-motion and when the tab is hidden.

Conventions: all copy/data in src/data/content.js (PROJECTS, STATS, WORK_CARDS, EXPERIENCE, SKILL_ROWS, ABOUT, FORM_STEPS, NAV_*, SOCIALS); class-based CSS in src/styles/site.css with tokens in src/styles/tokens/*.css; components in src/components, page sections in src/sections. Background is @paper-design/shaders-react GrainGradient with a CSS blob fallback (three.js dropped). Portrait lives at public/tanisha.png (a wordmark promo graphic, not a photo). SEO build (2026-09-06): `npm run build` = client build + `vite build --ssr src/entry-server.jsx` + scripts/prerender.mjs, which writes dist/index.html and dist/work/<id>.html with per-page head from src/seo.js (title, description, canonical, OG/Twitter, JSON-LD graph) plus dist/sitemap.xml. main.jsx hydrates. Case routes are /work/<id> (Vercel cleanUrls serves work/<id>.html); hash form still parsed. SITE_URL lives in content.js; change it when a custom domain lands. Fonts self-hosted in public/fonts (WOFF2 + the two OTFs), icons bundled from src/assets/icons, OG images in public/og (generated with PIL). vercel.json sets a strict CSP; any new third-party script or host needs a CSP update.

Design direction (final, 2026-09-06 late): the user tried a minimalist rebuild (commit 627b5e1) and then asked for the EARLIER cinematic format back, keeping the CHERRY-RED dynamic gradient. Current site = the pre-minimalist layout from commit 1d51d16 (preloader, glass nav + drawer, hero with rotating word, About bento with tabs + abstract portrait, skills columns + marquee, experience rail, recognition strip, 4 work cards with case dialogs, contact with email-first + form, big footer) with every cyan token swapped to cherry: accent #E5203F, rgba(229,32,63,…), shader palette hsl(348/352/345), blobs rgba(229,32,63)/(170,16,48)/(150,16,44)/(240,90,110). Fonts back to Geist/Geist Mono/Instrument Serif + Nasalization + Bastliga. Favicon and OG cards are the cherry versions. If the user asks for a palette change again, do it by token replacement in src/styles, Background.jsx PALETTE, and public/portrait-abstract.svg.

Placeholders and hooks for missing assets: RESUME_URL and BLOG_URL in src/data/content.js are null, which hides the Resume/Blog links everywhere (hero shows 'See the work' instead). Portrait card loads public/portrait.jpg first and falls back to the generated public/portrait-abstract.svg when the photo is missing; the old tanisha.png wordmark is no longer shown. Contact details are real (tanishabrahma26@gmail.com, @mysstttt, github.com/Junecoderr, medium.com/@Junecodder, Durgapur). User rule: no mention of the reference design author or site anywhere on the website. Backlog offered 2026-09-06 (not started): long-form case pages, ATT&CK heatmap + incident timeline visuals, Medium RSS writing section, build-time resume PDF, talks media + Event/credential schema, live GitHub facts, references; security.txt + /pgp.txt + site threat model + console banner; contact backend (Vercel fn + Resend), branded 404, Lighthouse CI + axe, visual regression snapshots, Dependabot + Sentry, content schema validation, save-data shader skip, hover prefetch, light theme.

User preferences: favour confident credibility copy over disclaimers (footer line "Every claim on this site is one I can defend in an interview" is the about-quote). Prefers to be asked follow-up questions rather than have assumptions made, but once a decision is given, execute without re-asking. Project memory file path is cwd-relative: portfolio-website/.claude/memories/project_memory.json.

Standing caveat: case-study metrics, client names, CVE identifiers, talks and bounty figures all originate from the design template, not from Tanisha. Flagged to the user on 2026-09-06 as the top risk (now also in JSON-LD). Do not present them as verified; ask the user to confirm or replace before any further SEO submission.
